description: This file manages chat history context, including functions for building, appending, evicting, and clearing history entries, as well as handling history maps and context markers.

classes.name: HistoryEntry
classes.description: Type defining a chat history entry with sender, body, timestamp, and messageId.

methods.name: evictOldHistoryKeys
methods.description: Removes oldest keys from a history map when exceeding max size.

methods.name: buildHistoryContext
methods.description: Constructs a history context string from history text and current message.

methods.name: appendHistoryEntry
methods.description: Adds a new entry to the history map under a specific key, maintaining size limit.

methods.name: recordPendingHistoryEntry
methods.description: Alias for appending a history entry.

methods.name: recordPendingHistoryEntryIfEnabled
methods.description: Conditionally appends a history entry if it exists and limit > 0.

methods.name: buildPendingHistoryContextFromMap
methods.description: Builds history context string from a map of history entries.

methods.name: buildHistoryContextFromMap
methods.description: Builds history context string from a history map, optionally including a new entry.

methods.name: clearHistoryEntries
methods.description: Clears all history entries for a given key.

methods.name: buildHistoryContextFromEntries
methods.description: Creates a history context string from an array of entries.
